scientific_integrity: Proof, all cutoff values, and independent small-order enumeration are supplied in the attached files. No external independent review or formal verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: First raw moment only; no inference that either class of subsets is numerically dominant. Exact formula holds for every integer parameter n at least 2, finite range is checked by a standalone exact-integer certificate, infinite range follows from a proved lower bound. Prior indexed literature was compared, but unindexed earlier computations remain possible.
title: Sharp first-moment sign transition for dicyclic product–quotient sets
